name: Subnautica
description: Dive into the alien ocean with friends. Nitrox puts several players in the same Subnautica world: the same reefs, bases, vehicles and creatures, with one player hosting the server.

setup.title: Subnautica
setup.detail: Install Subnautica from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts Nitrox in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts Nitrox in the game's folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play: Nitrox's own window opens. Create a server there, choose its game mode and start it.
Share your address with your friends. The server's port (11000) must be open on your router, or use a VPN you share.
Choose your server in Nitrox and press Start to play.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play to open Nitrox.
Choose Multiplayer, add the host's address and press Join.
Pick your player name and start: you arrive in the host's world.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: One player hosts a Nitrox server and friends join by address. Everyone needs the same version of the mod.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs Nitrox in the game's folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: One ocean
items.detail: Players share the world, bases, vehicles and creatures.

items.name: Players
items.detail: Each player is seen by the others, with their own inventory and progress.
